title: Bible Web App Unified Configuration
description: Single configuration file for the Bible web app. Consolidates server config, module settings, search pipeline knobs, and UI defaults. Place in the data directory as site-config.json.

auth.description: Authentication settings for the password gate.

enabled.description: Whether the password gate is active. When false, the app is accessible without login.

passwordHash.description: Pre-computed password hash (salt:hash). If present, 'password' is ignored.

password.description: Plain-text password. Will be hashed and replaced with 'passwordHash' on first server start.

features.description: Feature flags to enable or disable optional functionality.

tagGraph.description: Enable the tag graph visualization feature.

semanticSearch.description: Enable semantic (Ideas) search. Requires a search pipeline config.

pwa.description: Enable PWA (manifest + service worker). When false, the app behaves as a regular website with no offline support or install prompt.

offlineDownloads.description: Allow users to manually mark modules for offline use.

offlineAutoDownload.description: Automatically cache a lite copy of a translation in the browser the first time it is read. Turn off to keep every visitor from pulling several MB per translation.

modules.description: Module visibility and grouping settings (replaces settings.json).

about.description: Custom 'About' text displayed in the app settings panel.

commentaryPopularity.description: Commentary module popularity ranking (lower number = more popular). Used for default sort order when no explicit sortOrders are configured.

staleDays.description: Number of days before auto-downloaded Bible modules are considered stale and eligible for cleanup.

search.description: Search pipeline configuration knobs. The full provider config remains in a separate file.

mode.description: Where semantic (Ideas) search runs. 'server': the server builds the embedding pipeline (high RAM). 'browser': clients search locally via a Web Worker and self-hosted model/index, keeping the server lean. 'off': semantic search disabled. The server only builds the in-process pipeline when set to 'server'.

pipelineConfigPath.description: Path to the search pipeline provider config file (relative to data directory). Only used when mode is 'server'.

hybrid.description: Enable hybrid keyword + semantic search by default.

minScore.description: Minimum relevance score for semantic search results.

ui.description: UI customization options. Themes and fonts are defined in code; these settings control which are visible.

defaultTheme.description: Default theme ID for new users.

visibleThemes.description: Restrict available themes to this list of theme IDs. If omitted, all themes are available.

visibleFonts.description: Restrict available font schemes to this list of font scheme IDs. If omitted, all fonts are available.

defaultModule.description: Default Bible module abbreviation for new users (e.g., "KJV").

defaultDisplayMode.description: Default display mode for the Bible pane.

disabledPanes.description: Panes to disable in the UI (e.g., ["dictionary", "interlinear"]).

privacy.description: Privacy posture for deployments where minimizing data footprint matters (e.g., users in high-risk regions).

mode.description: Privacy posture. 'strict' (default): session-only auth cookies, in-memory rate limiting, logger scrubs IPs and refuses client-identifying data. 'relaxed': persistent cookies and optional request-level logging.

repoUrl.description: URL to the source code repository, shown in the About panel.

docsUrl.description: URL of the external documentation website. When set, the Help dialog shows a prominent link to it; when empty or omitted, no link is shown.

active.description: Whether this module is visible to users.

sortOrder.description: Explicit sort order for this module (lower = first).

section.description: A named group of modules displayed together in the UI.

title.description: Section heading shown in the module selector.

helpText.description: Optional help text displayed below the section heading.

modules.description: Ordered list of module abbreviations in this section.

moduleTypeConfig.description: Configuration for one module type (bibles, commentaries, or dictionaries).

modules.description: Map of module abbreviation to its configuration.

sections.description: Ordered sections for grouping modules in the UI.
